name: sam-audio-bench
description: A benchmark dataset for evaluating audio-model capabilities on a variety of audio understanding tasks (e.g., classification, detection, and transcription). It measures model robustness and generalization across diverse audio examples and annotation types provided in the dataset. The benchmark is intended to compare performance of audio models on standard metrics and to surface common failure modes.
reputation: A small community dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing adoption among audio-model benchmarking efforts.
